Quotes the Stanford working paper's measured employment decline in AI-exposed jobs.
Reports Yale Budget Lab finding no economy-wide disruption, plus the Oxford Economics view that some layoffs are blamed on AI without cause.

receipt.public_excerpt: CEO Marc Benioff claimed the CRM company has cut its customer support workforce by almost 50% thanks to the use of its own agentic AI platform, Agentforce.

evidence_items.explanation: Salesforce's CEO says support headcount fell from about 9,000 to about 5,000 because AI agents now handle the work. This is a documented case of AI replacing employee roles, though it is company-reported and not independently checked.

receipt.public_excerpt: early-career workers (ages 22-25) in the most AI-exposed occupations have experienced a 13% relative decline in employment even after controlling for firm-level shocks

evidence_items.explanation: Payroll data through July 2025 show a measured employment decline in occupations where AI automates work. This cuts against both 'we can't measure AI job loss' and 'it does not replace jobs'. The authors warn that other factors may play a part.

receipt.public_excerpt: “The picture of AI’s impact on the labor market that emerges from our data is one that largely reflects stability, not major disruption at an economy-wide level.”

evidence_items.explanation: Aggregate tracking finds no economy-wide AI job disruption. This backs his softer point that AI job loss is not showing up at scale.

receipt.public_excerpt: “We suspect some firms are trying to dress up layoffs as a good news story rather than bad news, such as past over-hiring,” the Oxford report said.

evidence_items.explanation: Suggests that some layoffs firms blame on AI are really about other causes. This weakens CEO claims such as Block's, but it does not cancel the Salesforce account.

receipt.public_excerpt: Dorsey didn’t mince words in an X post announcing the cuts, tying the layoffs directly to an efficiency boost from the company’s AI implementation.

evidence_items.explanation: Block cut about 4,000 jobs and tied the cut to AI. Dorsey also cited overhiring, so this does not clearly show AI doing the work. Context only.

unresolved_gaps: Salesforce's account is the CEO's own; no independent check that AI agents do the work of the departed staff.
It is not clear whether any of the Salesforce support roles were contract positions.
The Stanford finding is correlational, and its authors note that other factors may play a part.
